items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...They got Raymond Brown? Yeah. Joe Ball, do you know Joe Ball? ... [INTERVIEWEE] What did he play?

ctx.x: Yeah, no. No, I'm trying to tell them. Oh yeah. Overture as well. Yeah, all the pieces. I can't call the name. Oh shit, I can't call the name.
